target: Unblock the facade's dope-context tools via an MCP JSON-RPC (streamable HTTP) client bridge; register the facade in mcp_catalog.yaml; add an inventory-freshness CI gate.

TOOL_CONTRACT.md's 12-tool contract is authoritative; an exposed==contract test guards it.

commit.message: feat(dcp-facade): dope-context JSON-RPC bridge; catalog registration; freshness gate

pr.title: feat(dcp-facade): unblock dope-context tools + catalog registration
pr.body:
search_code_docs/get_index_status currently return BLOCKED because the facade client is REST-only. Adds a streamable-HTTP JSON-RPC client for dope-context (POST 127.0.0.1:3010/mcp), registers the facade in the catalog (operator-run stdio lifecycle), and adds a CI gate that fails when exposed tools drift from TOOL_CONTRACT.md.

Anchor: claudedocs/mcp-fleet-reconciliation-2026-07-18.md (P7/HRD).

steps.task: Implement the MCP JSON-RPC streamable-HTTP client in the facade and route search_code_docs/get_index_status through it.
validation: Integration test against a live dope-context returns real search results and index status (no BLOCKED sentinel).

steps.task: Register the facade in mcp_catalog.yaml (operator-run stdio, documented lifecycle) and add the inventory-freshness CI gate (exposed==TOOL_CONTRACT).
validation: Catalog contains the facade entry and drift check passes; CI gate fails on a deliberately-broken contract fixture and passes on the real surface.
